title: Pentaho Analyst - BA Practitioner
description: Hands-on workshop for the Pentaho Business Analytics Practitioner. Pentaho User Console, Interactive Reports, Analyzer Reports, Dashboard Designer, plus a MongoDB reporting use case.

assistant.subject: Pentaho Business Analytics (the User Console, Interactive Reports, Analyzer and Dashboard Designer)
suggestions: What's the difference between Interactive Reports and Analyzer?
How do I add a filter to an Analyzer report?
How do I publish a dashboard so others can see it?
What can I do in the User Console?

moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: Set up your environment and orient yourself with the Pentaho Business Analytics tooling before diving into the hands-on labs.

moduleSummaries.title: User Console
moduleSummaries.summary: Tour the Pentaho User Console (PUC) — the browser-based home for browsing data sources, opening reports, and managing schedules.

moduleSummaries.title: Interactive Reports
moduleSummaries.summary: Build ad-hoc reports for business users with Interactive Reports. Three guided exercises: Sales Territory, Orders for NA and EMEA, and Ships and Trains.

moduleSummaries.title: Analyzer Reports
moduleSummaries.summary: Slice, dice, and pivot OLAP data with Analyzer. Two exercises: Sales Analysis and EMEA Quantity.

moduleSummaries.title: Dashboard Designer
moduleSummaries.summary: Assemble interactive dashboards combining reports, charts, and filters. Three exercises: Vendor Sales, Inventory, and Product Performance.
